WITH player_vote_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.death_country,
        AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max <> 0
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT death_country, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM player_vote_averages
    GROUP BY death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_ratio,
    avg_ratio / AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean
FROM country_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Award-vote record” refers to records in player_award_vote; each player is identified by player_id, so their valid vote ratios are averaged together before grouping by death_country. Blank death_country values remain a single NULL group.
